items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: It was right past where Jimmy Ryan's was.

ctx.x: Helbach/Helbock(?). He was a bartender. It was a private house, and you had to walk up... It was right past where Jimmy Ryan's was. It was a walk-up, and you went... It was a private house, and you went in... This is where Spirits of Rhythm were playing all the time.

Now, next to it, they built the Famous Door. It was a door in white. It looked like the entry to a Southern plantation -- the Famous Door. And the guy that was the host was Ran(?) somebody-or-the-other -- I forget his name. But eventually, they moved, and he went with them when they moved to California.
